listenings.text: Thank you for calling reception. If your request is urgent, please press zero at any time and the call will ring the night manager directly. For housekeeping, press one. If you need an adaptor, an extra pillow or an iron, press one as well and we can bring it to your room at any hour. For the restaurant and room service, press two. Please note that the kitchen closes at eleven, although sandwiches are available all night. The business centre on the second floor is open until eleven at night and opens again at six in the morning, and you will need your room key to get in. For anything else, stay on the line and somebody will be with you shortly.

Hi, it is me. I need to ask you a favor and I want to say straight away that you can say no. There is a call at four this afternoon about the offshore accounts, and there is one question I know they will ask, and you are the only person who can answer it properly. I will be on a plane and I will not be able to connect. So if you are around at four, could you join for ten minutes and take that one question? If you cannot, honestly, it is not urgent enough to change your day, and I will move the call to Monday. Let me know either way. Thanks.

extra_audio.text: Ruth asks Janderson for his passport. He asks her a favor, because his room has no desk and he has a call at seven. Ruth offers to move him to a smaller room on the fourth floor. He asks whether she is the person in charge of the rooms. Ruth says she will let him know in five minutes if the room is available.
